items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: We all belong to the same club, the Friendly Fifty... I said, hey, what do you say, Buddy? Hey, Hap. I said, I'm coming by so we can -- want to bring you up there and got a little jam session. He wouldn't come.

ctx.x: (Unintelligible). Well, just going back to this sort of order of tenor players again. Now, all those Texas people -- I mean like the Budd Johnsons and --
-- Buddy Tate, now they come up there because -- and Herschel Evans.
